AI isn’t just chatbots anymore 🤖

In 2026, it’s a full stack:

🧠 LLM → the brain (generates answers)
📚 RAG → the knowledge (pulls real-time data)
🤖 Agents → the hands (take actions, use tools)
🏢 Agentic AI → the system (multiple agents working together)

⚡ Simple way to think:

LLM = brain
RAG = knowledge
Agents = execution
Agentic AI = organization

Don’t just learn AI models learn how to build systems around them.
